_doc: Registry of every X account in the user's finance following list (xlsx supplied 2026-09-02), classified by whether it makes India-listed single-stock calls. Drives the x-handle-triage (finite backlog: deep 6-month tweet pass of every deep_pass:true handle, oldest xlsx_row first) and x-handle-ranking (mechanical scoreboard) routines. buckets: A1=high-signal single-name caller, A2=probable/lower-volume, B=equities-adjacent no actionable calls, X=not India stock-picking, CC=credit-cards (ignored), cluster=already in x_cluster.json. Only A1/A2 get deep_pass. tier: candidate|cluster|primary|watch|out-of-scope|ignored|rejected.
